name: codex-factory
description: Budgeted boss-and-worker orchestration for Codex and qualified local models.

interface.longDescription: Codex Factory discovers and qualifies Codex and local-model workers, routes bounded tasks to the eligible pool, enforces execution budgets, and records auditable receipts.
